name: mindsharp
description: MindSharp — mental-arithmetic fitness tracker. Vanilla JS frontend + Vercel serverless functions + Supabase.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:events && npm run check:csp && npm run check:manifest && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run e2e
scripts.build: npm run check:secrets && npm run check:prod
scripts.assets:native: npx capacitor-assets generate --iconBackgroundColor '#16120c' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#16120c' --splashBackgroundColor '#16120c' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#16120c' && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/fix-manifest.mjs && node scripts/make-manifests.mjs
scripts.android: npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:build: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
